slides.label: Verse 1
lines: <s1384>My Father and my friend
The rock of my salvation
You mean so much to me
You are the lover of my soul</s>

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: <s1384>The very air I breath
You’re my everything
You are the beauty of my life</s>

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: <s1384>Lord Jesus, You are the song I sing
Your goodness to me is amazing
Lord, Your love for me is like no other
Shepherd of my soul
You daily load me with benefits
Unchanging is Your love for me</s>
